[SWS_CM_11014] Unbinding a BuiltinParticipantListener from a DDS Domain- Participant
⌈
When instructed to unbind a BuiltinParticipantListener from
a DDS DomainParticipant, the DDS binding implementation service shall invoke the
DomainParticipant’s set_listener() method to disable the listener. In that case,
set_listener() shall be called with StatusMask = STATUS_MASK_NONE.
⌋
